scenario: Section 3.2 - Nominal Cuff Inflation and Step Deflation
test_idea: Initiate a standard measurement sequence on a test simulator, observe the initial cuff inflation phase, and monitor the controlled deflation steps.
expected_result: The device successfully inflates the cuff to the initial target of 180 mmHg and deflates in controlled steps of approximately 3 mmHg to capture oscillometric data.

scenario: Section 3.2 - Incremental Inflation Beyond Initial Target
test_idea: Configure the simulator to suppress pulse detection until the initial target of 180 mmHg is reached, and monitor the subsequent pressure adjustment steps.
expected_result: The device detects no pulse at 180 mmHg and correctly executes an inflation increment of 40 mmHg to continue searching for the pulse.

test_idea: Configure the patient simulator to completely withhold pulse detection throughout the entire measurement cycle up to the highest possible inflation limit.
expected_result: The device reaches the maximum threshold of 299 mmHg in increments without detecting a pulse and aborts the measurement process with an error.

scenario: Section 1.1 - Nominal Adult Arm Circumference Verification
test_idea: Fit the CT-200 cuff to an adult patient simulator with an arm circumference of 28 cm. Initiate measurement and verify reading acquisition.
expected_result: The device successfully acquires systolic, diastolic, and pulse rate readings without sizing errors.

scenario: Section 3.2 - Nominal Cuff Inflation and Pulse Acquisition
test_idea: Connect the CT-200 to a patient simulator with normal pulse signal detectable below 180 mmHg. Power on the device, select User Profile 1, and press Start. Observe the initial inflation phase and pressure gauge reading.
expected_result: The cuff inflates smoothly to the initial target of 180 mmHg, acquires oscillometric pulse data, and initiates controlled deflation in steps of approximately 3 mmHg to complete the reading.

test_idea: Execute standard inflation cycle on a test subject with systolic pressure below 250 mmHg. Monitor emergency valve status during inflation.
expected_result: Emergency deflation valve remains securely closed throughout nominal inflation below 299 mmHg.
